name: com.gameyogi.utilitytools
description: A lightweight set of Unity Editor productivity tools: AI Console (a Console replacement that writes token-lean status / issues / JSONL files AI agents can read), ULog per-system logging that compiles out of release builds, inspector [Button] attribute for MonoBehaviours and ScriptableObjects, scene switcher overlay, inspector lock, play-from-bootstrap, live time-scale control, and one-click settings / asset shortcuts.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour and a ScriptableObject showing every [Button] option: modes, colors, confirmation, parameters, coroutines and return values.
ULog channels, structured fields, nested exceptions, repeats, background-thread logs and lazy messages — open the AI Console to see them.
